d: One Week after reports that US President Donald Trump and the Pentagon were planning to drop the 'Mother of All Bombs' on Iranian infrastructure, Iran has now shot back at Trump by claiming that the IRGC will unveil the 'Father of All Bombs.' Reports suggest that US President Donald Trump is considering using the GBU-43/B Massive Air Ordnance Blast or MOAB on Iran. The bomb is the most powerful air-launched non-nuclear weapon in US arsenal and is dropped using a C-130 aircraft.
